recipes.name: tails
recipes.description: Tails 7.12 (x86_64 only) — amnesic live OS, routes all traffic through Tor
recipes.caveats:
This is a live-USB ISO, not a command. Find it with:

    hop info tails

Write it to a USB drive (Tails is meant to boot from removable media, not a
virtual disk) or mount it in a hypervisor for testing.

Tails publishes only a PGP signature for this image, not a plain checksum,
so hop cannot pre-verify it the way it does everything else in this index —
the digest is recorded on first install (trust-on-first-use) instead.
Verify the signature yourself against Tails' signing key if that matters for
your use case: https://tails.net/tails-signing.key
